programme.desc: The Mediterranean Grill: Physicians have long extolled the virtues of the Mediterranean diet. Today the healthy foods and vibrant flavors of the Mediterranean hit the grill when Steven grills Sicilian grilled artichokes and branzino stuffed with fennel stalks. Then there's Greek grilled baby lamb chops with ember roasted potatoes prepared by friend and host of My Greek Table, Diane Kochilas.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Mediterranean Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: For many, barbecue means meat. But you may be surprised to learn that one of the earliest recorded barbecues featured fish wrapped in grape leaves. Today Steven begins with saffron-scented Catalan shrimp kebabs, followed by trout Mexican style with a sizzling garlic cilantro sauce. Then there's a Mystery Box that will astonish you as much as it surprised Steven.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Water Meets Fire

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Wagyu Demystified: Wagyu, "Japanese cow" literally, was once an obscure cattle breed from Japan. Today, it's on restaurant menus and in butcher shops around the world. Get ready for a sumptuous Japanese A5 Rib-Eye with sesame salt and grilled rice cakes, followed by wagyu steak tomahawks with fire-roasted marrow. Then feast your eyes on wagyu smash burgers with parmesan crisps.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wagyu Demystified

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Influential Grilling: Scroll through the images on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, and you'll find grilled and smoked dishes of astonishing ingenuity. In the spirit of this new style of barbecue, we've invited three of my favorite influencers to grill with me - Derek Wolf from Over the Fire Cooking, Scott Thomas from Grillin' Fools, and Susie Bulloch from Hey Grill Hey.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Influential Grilling

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Chef Stellino shares his sauce making secrets, to inspire the viewers with this elegant and sophisticated Mango and Ginger sauce that is easy to make and tastes delicious! He also shares some important fact about the uniqueness of the Black cod and his step by step secrets on how to plate this dish with the refined elegance of a professional chef.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Black Cod with Mango and Ginger Sauce and Sautéed Green Beans

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Meatloaf when done right can be a work of art, something worthy of the finest restaurant. It is all about technique and it is never hard to do right. Chef Stellino re-interprets for his viewers a fabulous Sicilian recipe from his youth and in the process he shares with them a series of foolproof techniques for getting done right every time.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Stuffed Meatloaf and Cake with Rum Sauce!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Cooking the perfect pork chop and preparing the ultimate sauce with port and Gorgonzola is a easy as 1-2-3! Making the perfect ricotta cheesecake is even easier. Chef Stellino loves to share his tips and techniques with a passionate delivery and easy to follow instructions.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Chops with Port & Gorgonzola Sauce and Ricotta Cheesecake

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: How not to overcook shrimp!! Chef Stellino guides the viewer though a series of tips and techniques on how to make incredibly flavorful shrimp recipes which are fool proof and look and taste like a million dollars.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Sizzling Shrimp Dishes

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Some call this the ultimate dinner, a perfectly cooked NY steak with a Vodka martini sauce! Chef Stellino once again shares all of his secrets in the making a an iconic sauce , the perfect accompaniment to the king of steaks: The New York. Then to sum it all up he shares with us a lusciously sweet, easy to make dessert of pears braised with Marsala!
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Ultimate Steak Dinner

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: A soup can be a form of art! Chef Stellino shares his secrets for the perfect soups, smooth , luscious and elegant. Plus he shows the viewers a series of simple techniques to create elegant topping to dress it all up. Simple clear instructions with step by step demonstrations on how to get it done in one try!
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Luscious Soups!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: A great dish does not have to be difficult to make in order to taste great! Fresh ingredients and simple techniques are at the core of these fabulously, delicious recipes. Chef Stellino guides the viewers along each step with humor and passion. He also shares his plating techniques that will help the viewers enhance the look of their finished dishes.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Grilled Shrimp with Peppers and Tuna with Tomato Salad

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: The key to every fabulous entrée, is a fabulous sauce. Chef Stellino guides you through a the simple preparation of an elegant sauce for your everyday meal. A blast from the past ,a sweet upside-down pineapple cake that will rekindle your memory and seduce your palate.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Pork Chops and Pineapple Upside-down Cake

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara kicks off with a street food tour in Rome led by American Ex Pat Katie Parla. Then, they perform a Roman hat trick - three pastas starting with the same delicious base: Gricia made with guanciale transforms into Amatriciana by adding tomatoes or Carbonara by adding eggs. In her own kitchen, Sara makes baked penne with prosciutto and Fontina cheese.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Essential Pastas of Rome

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Saras and her guest Cristina Bowerman go on a delicious journey through Cristina's Trastevere neighborhood to pick up ingredients for Cristina's meatless Celeriac and Orange pizza topped with tea and herb oil. In her own kitchen, Sara makes a Spaghetti Squash pasta with walnuts and a creamy goat cheese sauce. Plus, an American in Rome living the dream as a food photographer.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: In Naples, Sara unlocks the secret recipe for the best Neapolitan pizza at the famous Gino Sorbillos. Fried meat filled pizza may be even better than that, or is the best one a unique star shaped pizza? Just across the bay in Sorrento it's all lemons, all the time as Sara visits a proud family of lemon growers. They make a citrus flecked cheese and Grandma's Lemon Pasta.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Pizza and Lemons: Naples to Sorrento

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Parma, Italy is home to Parmesan cheese, Prosciutto di Parma and some of the best tomatoes in Italy. All three go into a dish Sara cooks with a local chef. You won't find a quicker weeknight meal than his fancy sounding Tagliatelle con Crema di Parmigiana Passata. Sara's Parsley and Asparagus salad makes it a meal. Later, Sara cooks with Italian American chef Joey Campanaro.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Bounty of Parma

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: How do you make any dish even more delicious? Just add cheese! To prove the point Sara's got two recipes: a French Onion Soup Burger topped with melty, gooey cheese and an equally gooey Alsatian Onion Pie with caramelized onions and melted Gruyere that puts it over the top. Later, we visit a dairy farm and then on 'Ask Sara', an easy homemade ricotta.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's strategy for easy weeknight cooking? Simply cook a dish one night, then repurpose it into a different meal for another night. Maya Kaimal joins Sara to make Turkey Keema with sweet potatoes and ground meat. On another night, that morphs into Indian stuffed peppers. Then Sara Sautee's Duck Breasts for a quick meal. She uses those same Duck Breasts in a mouthwatering Peking Duck Wrap.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Weeknight Two for One

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Holidays and special occasions call for showstopping main courses that take a little extra time. Vegetarians, this one's for you - Sara's elegant Butternut Squash and Date Crostata. Then it's Sara's crispy Roast Duck with Duck Fat Popovers. Also a feature on a woman who is saving the recipes of Italian grandmothers she calls 'Pasta Grannies'.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: In Spain, paella is so popular there are competitions between towns for the best recipe. It is especially so in Valencia, where Sara cooks with local chef Franck Garanger. If we didn't have you at Paella, just wait for the dinner where it's eaten right out of the pan with special rules for pilfering your dinner partners portion. Then, Sara sautés fish topped with a colorful Gazpacho Vinaigrette.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Sketches of Spain

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Wrangler Tailgate. Since picnickers in 1869 ate food from buckboards of horse-drawn wagons, Americans have loved tailgating. Now the party goes global, with pulled lamb from a wood-burning smoker at Odys & Penelope in L.A. Honey Soy Chicken Wings on skewers and Brisket Tacos, make magisterial main dishes. True global tailgating, with a Peruvian potato salad with chili-spiked cheese sauce.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wrangler Tailgate

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Extreme Grilling. Long before grills, charcoal, rotisseries, and planchas, there was fire! We visit L.A.'s Chi SPACCA, for a monster pork tomahawk grilled over wood by chef Ryan DeNicola. Extreme grilling with salmon steaks, smoky, on a shovel in a blazing campfire. Caveman-style pork chops directly on blazing embers with a sizzling poblano pan-fry and decadent brownies on a cedar plank.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Extreme Grilling

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Grilling 24/7. The world's pit masters, fire up grills, smokers, or wood-burning ovens for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late night snacks. For breakfast, farm eggs grilled with Parmesan, and prosciutto. For lunch, pizzas from the Industrial Eats in Buellton, CA. Pastrami Beef Ribs make a spectacular supper, and midnight snack of smoky, salty South African Grilled Cheese sandwiches.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: One Good Turn. Rotisserie grilling or spit-roasting combines the smoky sear of grilling with the heat of roasting. Add 3 more benefits: basting, no flare-ups, and the fragrance of wood smoke. Game hens acquire golden, crackling-crisp skin. Spare ribs are given the huli-huli (turn-turn) treatment. Wings get a sweet-salty, lacquer-like glaze. Finally, a whole spinning, sugar-crusted pineapple.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - One Good Turn

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: We reinvent the cocktail party, with the power of live fire to take finger food over the top with rum and citrus-glazed jumbo shrimp grilled on sugarcane, "finger-burner" lamb chops from Spain and Smoked Nectarine Bellinis to keep conversation flowing. Sommelier Kristine Bocchino shares suggestions for three great wines to serve at the party.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Grill Top Cocktail Party

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee sets out to find two unique Southern California speakeasies. The super secret "The Blind Rabbit" has a hidden door just outside a Chinese Noodle shop. To get into "Lock & Key", Tamee must find the one working door knob on a wall with over 500.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee heads to LA's China Town to serve up apothecary style cocktails at "GENERAL LEE'S". This historic bar was originally founded in 1868. Then it's off to Van Nuys CA for some beer, darts & bagpipes at the craft brewery "MACLEOD ALE BREWING COMPANY".

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee takes us to the corner of Hollywood & Vine to "LOST PROPERTY BAR" where you can sip on a rare whiskey take home odd items other guests have left behind! Then it's off to the underground hot spot "THE ASSOCIATION" for old school classic cocktails.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee visits 2 bars in Culver City, CA that are radically different, but have something strangely in common.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee visits LOCK AND KEY SOCIAL DRINKERY & KITCHEN in Downey CA. Bourbon & beef are the pride of this neighborhood hangout where the specialties of the house are a 4O ounce Tomahawk Steak and the Billionaire Cocktail.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee sets out for an evening of Cocktails, Peruvian Food & Live Jazz in Hollywood CA. The best thing about this adventure, is she found all three under one roof! Welcome to Los Balcones & The Parker Room.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee visits SCRATCH RESTAURANT & WOODLEY PROPER in Encino CA. to meet a husband & wife chef team that push the limits of gourmet food and cocktails. Two dazzling venues under one roof with a head mixologist that is also a world class magician.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Highland Park CA is filled with serious restaurants and craft cocktail bars but remains under the mainstream radar. Today Tamee enjoys food and drinks at CAFE BIRDIE then heads to the back alley for classic cocktails at the speakeasy GOOD HOUSEKEEPING.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee gets a taste of Italy in Downtown Los Angeles at a restaurant & bar that specializes in Northern Italian Food & Cocktails. Pasta is made by hand and drinks are made by the Godfather Of Cocktails at ROSSOBLU.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Today Tamee challenges the mixologists to create sports themed cocktails and enjoys a surf & turf meal with Chef Perry Pollaci at the stunning hilltop restaurant & bar CASTAWAY in Burbank, CA.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee is high atop the Hollywood Hills at a restaurant & bar with a rich history that dates back to 1914. She's treated to beautiful views, delicious food, a magnificent 600 year old Pagoda & wonderfully creative Japanese inspired cocktails at YAMASHIRO

programme.title: Primal Grill
programme.desc: Recipes include: Mussels in Pine Needles, Salmon on a Stick, Prosciutto Garlic Bread and Caveman T-Bones.

programme.title: Primal Grill
programme.desc: Recipes include: Jamaican Jerk Chicken, Sugarcane Shrimp and Buccaneer Baby Backs.

programme.title: Primal Grill
programme.desc: There's something about the open range that brings out the griller in all of us. Recipes include: Gaucho Beef Ribs, Brazilian Pineapple and Salt-Crusted Chicken.

programme.title: Primal Grill
programme.desc: A vision as old as civilization itself, a clay or brick oven fueled by live fire. Recipes include: Wood Oven Pizza, Sweet and Sour Duck and Grilled Pork Chops.

programme.title: Primal Grill
programme.desc: People grill all over Planet Barbeque but Steven believes no one does it better than in America. Recipes include: Martha's Vineyard Lobster, Texas Clod and Spit-roasted Pork.
programme.sub-title: Primal Grill - Burn In The USA

programme.title: Primal Grill
programme.desc: If you've dined at an Indian restaurant you've probably had tandoori grilled foods. Recipes include: Tandoori Salmon, Breads from the Tandoor and Chicken Tikka Kebabs.

programme.title: Primal Grill
programme.desc: If Steven had to pick a single favorite region for grilling, it would be Asia. Recipes include: Guamian Chicken Salad, Malaysian Swordfish, Cambodian Corn and Singapore Beef Sates.

programme.title: Primal Grill
programme.desc: You've asked for it, now a world tour of meatless grilling. Recipes include: Israeli Egg Pate, Malaysian Grilled Tofu and Thai Coconut Bananas.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore kicks off Serial Griller with "Hot Handhelds," grilling up bold favorites like Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwiches, Pork Gyros, char-grilled hot dogs, wings with blue cheese, and the juicy Hemingway Burger. No forks required!

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: In "All the Courses," Matt Moore celebrates East Nashville's Tomato Fest with a feast-Breakfast Pizzette, Tuna Nicoise, Scored Flank Steak with Dijon Caper Sauce, and Grilled Watermelon. A multi-course grilling adventure with Southern flair!

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore grills for friends, serving sausage, blade steaks, redneck potatoes, and a Bardstown Buck cocktail.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Host Matt Moore brings East and West together over charcoal on the Ammo Grill. Inspired by his travels to Japan and the renowned Hikiniku To Come experience, Matt serves up juicy Wagyu Hamburger Steaks alongside a lineup of crowd-pleasing favorites. The menu includes Chili Cheese Dawgs, Salmon Kabobs, and Bacon-Bratwurst Fried Rice, each showcasing bold flavors and live-fire cooking techniques.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore fires up his Hasty Bake grill outside his airplane hangar, surrounded by his Piper Cherokee and vintage military aircraft, for an Americana-inspired feast cooked over live fire. Drawing from his Lebanese and Syrian heritage, Matt starts with grilled beef kefta pitas before serving a smoky grilled Caesar salad and juicy grilled chicken thighs topped with vibrant salsa verde.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore showcases the versatility and convenience of gas grilling on the Napoleon Rogue Pro-S in an all-day celebration of outdoor cooking. The menu begins with family-favorite griddled breakfast smashburgers before moving to a grilled greens salad and grilled shrimp tostadas. Then, a Greek-inspired rotisserie beer can chicken with drip potatoes delivers a flavorful one-pan feast.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane embraces the words of Hippocrates, "Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food." She explores Greek staples-olive oil, herbs, nuts, veggies-as health foundations. Plus, three simple recipes and a chat with Dr. William Li, author of Eat to Beat Disease.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Let Food be Thy Medicine

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: How do you take a meat-centric plate and shift things around so that vegetables take up the prominent place and meat plays a secondary role? Diane and her son Yiorgos explore the geography of the dinner plate by recreating classic Greek recipes for meat with, well, less of it!
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Changing the Geography of the Dinner Plate

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane shares how shopping for, cleaning and cooking greens is easy and accessible. She visits her 96-year-old cousin's garden, this vibrant produce may hold the key to her longevity. In the kitchen, Diane prepares a green storm and sips a surprising elixir from cooked greens.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Greens Rule the Day

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Inspired by the ancient Greek philosopher and mathematician, Pythagoras, Diane explores plant-based cooking rooted in his ancient vegetarian philosophy. She discusses modern nutrition's alignment with Pythagorean principles and chats with Prof. John Wilkins on Ancient Greek foods and medicines.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Plant-Based in Ancient Greece

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane journeys from Greek forests to an Athenian restaurant exploring the health benefits of mushrooms. Plus, she chats with Dr. Andrew Weil on mushroom research and longevity, then cooks a mushroom gyro and braised mushroom-chickpea dish. She also tastes a rare recipe by Chef Gikas Xenakis.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Mushrooms for our Minds...Not What You Think!

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Beans are a superfood linked to longevity and play a starring role in Greek cuisine. Diane explores dried vs. canned beans, visits an Athens legume shop, and chats with Dr. William Li on their health benefits. She shares satisfying, easy-to-make recipes to help you eat well and feel great.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Beans-The #1 Longevity Ingredient

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Grains are the feel-good food of the Greek and Mediterranean diet, providing nutrition, versatility and soul-warming comfort. Diane visits Pnyka bakery where they grind their own flour from an ancient strain of grain. In the kitchen, Diane shares her knowledge and love of grains with 3 easy Greek-Mediterranean recipes.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Comfort Grains

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Fasting is deeply rooted in Greek culture and religion. Diane explores some of the plant-based foods of abstention that make up part of the fasting diet and speaks with Professor Valter Longo, whose research on the benefits of fasting for longevity and wellness have catapulted him to global renown.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Delicious Abstention

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's granddaughter Julia joins her in the kitchen to prepare a large pot of bubbling polenta and crostini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh pasta is an Italian family tradition passed through the generations. Today she starts with a silky pappardelle pasta dressed with pesto made from walnut, basil and parsley. She then takes the same pasta dough and shapes it into tortelloni stuffed with spinach and ricotta, dressed with a classic marinara sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a linguine with Swiss chard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia begins this meal with a savory zucchini and rice crostata. She then turns to the sweets with a celebration of zeppole, a fried delicious dough stuffed with creamy ricotta. Grandma Erminia, joins Lidia for this segment. Lastly, there is still time for a classic and Lidia prepares an easy steamed mussel dish with white wine, onions, bay leaves, and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: If you can't make it to Milan for a dish of "Risotto alla Milanese" bring the dish to your kitchen! Lidia begins today's meal with a creamy risotto alla Milanese with saffron and marrow bone followed by a succulent quail stuffed with Italian sausage and mushrooms. For dessert, it's an Italian classic - light and creamy panna cotta with seasonal berries.

programme.title: Of Trees & Forests: The Invisible World

programme.desc: Investigating the origins of civilization in Ireland; visiting several ancient sites, including Newgrange and the great Hill of Tara; what the ruins say about the Celtic people, their religion and some of the myths of Irish history.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Ireland and Northern Ireland
programme.desc: St. Patrick is one of the greatest figures in Irish history, linked to the story of both the island and Christianity; visiting several important sites that include Croagh Patrick, St. Patrick's Cathedral and the Clonmacnoise monastery.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Ireland and Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Irish history's entanglement with Great Britain; from the Norman castles to the battlefield of Aughrim, the Irish landscape is imbued with relics of British imperialism; exploring the British-Irish divide, which is also a Catholic-Protestant divide.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Ireland and Northern Ireland
programme.desc: An exploration of the 20th century; stops on the tour include the general post office in Dublin, which plays a role in the 1916 uprising; the town of Derry, home of the Bloody Sunday tragedy; a typical modern farmhouse in the Irish countryside.
programme.sub-title: From the Easter Rising to the Present Day

programme.title: America's Great Trails
programme.desc: Exploring the Pacific Crest Trail, an extraordinary route that stretches 2,650 miles from the deserts of Southern California on the Mexico border all the way to the Canadian border in Washington.

programme.title: America's Great Trails
programme.desc: Mick journeys along the hazardous 800-mile backcountry route of the Hayduke Trail.

programme.title: America's Great Trails
programme.desc: Traveling one of the most scenic and rugged long-distance trails in the world: the 1,200-mile Pacific Northwest Trail.

programme.title: America's Great Trails
programme.desc: At 3,100 miles, the Continental Divide Trail is the second-longest National Scenic Trail in the United States, and arguably the most rugged, remote, and hazardous of them all.

programme.title: America's Great Trails
programme.desc: Exploring a predominantly flat hiking trail from Pennsylvania's Pittsburgh to Maryland's Cumberland.

programme.title: America's Great Trails
programme.desc: Checking out the world's longest hiking trail, located in North America.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: Taking a virtual walk from the Washington Monument to the U.S. Capitol to explore the 4.54 billion-year history of Earth, with each stride representing 1 to 2 million years; along the way, fossils paint a picture of life on Earth from its start.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: Learning about those whose curiosity about the Earth and its fossils leads to the development of the science of paleontology; studying the geographic, climatic and chemical requirements for a living organism to leave behind its fossilized record.

programme.title: Cities of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Cities are integral to modern lives; why wandering ancient humans leave the forests and plains to create settlements; the fundamental question of "why" is the first step toward understanding the inhabitants and lessons from ancient cities.

programme.title: Cities of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Imagining a city with no streets, public buildings or common spaces; the world's first city offers an intriguing window into life in the Neolithic era; exploring the remains of Çatalhöyük's family housing, murals and religious shrines.
programme.sub-title: Çatalhöyük - First Experiment in Urban Living

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Moonstruck
programme.desc: A superstitious widow is ready to remarry...until she falls in love with her fiancé's brother!

programme.title: Pieces Of April
programme.desc: Rebellious daughter April offers to host family Thanksgiving dinner in her grubby Lower East Side apartment.

programme.title: Fargo
programme.desc: It's a homespun murder mystery that sees a very pregnant Police Chief on a case kidnapping.

programme.title: Leaving Las Vegas
programme.desc: In this 90s classic, a suicidal, career alcoholic falls for a compassionate Las Vegas hooker.

programme.title: Showgirls
programme.desc: Passion and power struggles unfold when a young woman will do anything to make it as a Las Vegas showgirl!

programme.title: Six Degrees Of Separation
programme.desc: Will Smith is a charming stranger who penetrates the world of a wealthy couple and alters their lives forever!

programme.title: Little Man Tate
programme.desc: Jodie Foster makes her directorial debut and stars in this drama about a single mother and her son.

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: Weird Al Yankovic plays a daydreamer who becomes the manager of a TV station that's losing ratings and money.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Ruth (Roseanne Barr) doesn't just vow to get her husband back from a romance novelist (Meryl Streep).

programme.title: Easy Money (1983)
programme.desc: When boozing Monty's mother-in-law leaves him an inheritance, he must change his ways before he can collect!

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: Wacky millionaire Thornton Melon enrolls in college...and higher education will never be the same again!

programme.title: Clifford
programme.desc: Martin Short stars as a ten-year-old who plans revenge on his uncle (Charles Grodin).

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
programme.desc: Two con men bet on who can bilk $50,000 from a wealthy woman in this dirty, rotten comedy!

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that's a fiesta of fun.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: Fiddler On The Roof
programme.desc: This lavish musical is the story of a poor man whose love and faith help him face oppression.

programme.title: Yentl
programme.desc: Barbra Streisand directs and stars as a young woman who poses as a boy to attend a Jewish religious school.

programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: When a Valley Girl finds love with a rocker, her girlfriends find him "grody to the max!"

programme.title: Throw Momma From The Train
programme.desc: Funnymen Danny DeVito and Billy Crystal are a momma's boy and a writer who "agree" to swap murders!

programme.title: The Cutting Edge
programme.desc: The unlikely duo of a retired hockey player and an elitist figure skater go for Olympic gold together.

programme.title: Eight Men Out
programme.desc: The true story of the infamous 1919 Chicago White Sox scandal, when the team throws the World Series.

programme.title: Bull Durham
programme.desc: Baseball season gets off to a rocky start when a veteran catcher and cocky young pitcher compete over a woman.

programme.title: Baby Boom
programme.desc: Diane Keaton shines as a driven career woman who finds her life turned upside down when she "inherits" a baby.

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: The Hot Spot
programme.desc: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

programme.title: The Crocodile Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Steve and Terri Irwin set out to save a crocodile, unaware that it's swallowed a U.S. satellite beacon, and now they're targets of the CIA! Crikey!

programme.title: Futureworld
programme.desc: After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims...

programme.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programme.desc: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.

programme.title: Cherry 2000
programme.desc: In this fun, futuristic sci-fi adventure, Melanie Griffith ("Something Wild") is delightful and unflappable as a bounty hunter on a mission to find a robot replicant of a rich man's short-circuited wife.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell) controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: Set against the wondrous backdrop of the Great Pyramids, "Stargate" tells the story of two very different men (Kurt Russell, James Spader) who join forces to unravel the mystery of a curious artifact which could reveal the origin of civilization.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Detective Jack Caine (Dolph Lundgren) thought he;d dealt with every kind of crime on earth, but someone "or something" is using human bodies to manufacture narcotics.

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, the black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. Three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: The Bounty
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins delivers a brilliant portrayal as William Bligh, the sea captain who, in 1787, steered The Bounty on a 27,000-mile voyage into danger, chaos and madness, and whose first mate (Mel Gibson) lead a legendary mutiny against him..

programme.title: Flesh + Blood
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: Warriors Of Virtue
programme.desc: A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: From legendary director William Wyler comes this bold, epic western, the story of a ship's captain (Gregory Peck) who ventures west to find a hotbed of jealousy, hatred and dangerous rivalries. Burl Ives won a Supporting Actor Oscar® for his role.

programme.title: Return Of The Seven
programme.desc: Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

programme.title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison...in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba
programme.desc: Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

programme.title: Gunslinger
programme.desc: When the town marshal is gunned down, his wife Rose (Beverly Garland) dons his badge. But now an evil dancehall diva (Allison Hayes) wants her dead and hires a gunslinger (John Ireland), who agrees to kill Rose...until he falls in love with her!

programme.title: Southwest Passage
programme.desc: Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: The King And Four Queens
programme.desc: Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks
programme.desc: In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

programme.title: Comes A Horseman
programme.desc: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother...who is blind.

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.

programme.title: Terror In A Texas Town
programme.desc: In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw
programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory - and a cunning woman - to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

programme.title: The Gunfight At Dodge City
programme.desc: Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!

programme.title: The Spikes Gang
programme.desc: Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) thinks he's been hired to kill wild dogs in Australia. But a wealthy cattle baron (Alan Rickman) has far more nefarious plans for the sharpshooter. Laura San Giacomo also stars in this stylish western.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Two best friends in 1964 Chicago cope with the challenges of everyday life and life in the housing projects.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: A straight-laced and successful executive's world is turned upside-down when he discovers the 17-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington in his feature film debut)!

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) discovers that he's the only one who believes that his childhood friend was framed for murder to protect the local tourism business.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Actor for Steiger.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: Lt. Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier), asks to be assigned to the case of a reverend accused of murder in San Francisco in hopes of clearing his friend's name.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier is back as Lt. Virgil Tibbs! When six masked figures rob a seemingly normal furniture factory, they leave with a multimillion-dollar cache of heroin!

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: When Harlem gangsters mess with the Mafia, an unlikely pair of New York's finest must work together to bring justice to the streets!

programme.title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
programme.desc: Two New York detectives suddenly find themselves on a wild goose chase for stolen cash that takes them from the Apollo Theater through the heart and soul of Harlem!

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

programme.title: Scream, Blacula, Scream!
programme.desc: Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Taking part in a nightclub hypnosis act, law student Ike becomes possessed with the spirit of a violent gangster murdered in the 1940s.

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend, Diana "Sugar" Hill, calls upon the voodoo high priest Baron Samedi to summon up the undead to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.

programme.title: Body And Soul (1981)
programme.desc: To help his family, an amateur enters the lucrative world of pro boxing. But he's soon swept up in his success and its temptations. Featuring the legendary Muhammed Ali.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: A boxer on-the-rise is asked to throw a fight by the local mob that has figured prominently in his success.

programme.title: Bucktown
programme.desc: Fred Williamson and Pam Grier star in this tense action drama about a man who comes to Bucktown to bury his slain brother.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: An ex-Vietnam, ex-Green Beret captain (Jim Brown) is out to avenge the murder of his parents by the psychotic Dominic Hoffo (Rip Torn).

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles. Nichelle Nichols also stars.

programme.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
programme.desc: A slick comedy that blows the 70s Blaxploitation movies right out of the hood! A decorated war hero, returns to the ghetto and enlist an army of original gangstas to clean it up in this mixture of nostalgia, silliness and unpredictable humor.

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: When a Jewish tailor (Zero Mostel) decides to give up on God, a mysterious man (Harry Belafonte) appears, claiming to be his Jewish guardian angel!

programme.title: Amazing Grace (1974)
programme.desc: Pious, church-going widow and grandma Grace (Jackie "Moms" Mabley) has a mouth that could take on the devil himself and the resolve to smack down an even bigger evil: politics!

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: A prison psychiatrist (the legendary Sidney Poitier) is charged with treating a hate-filled young man (Bobby Darin).

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Ram and Eddie are two jazz musicians living in Paris and falling in love with two young American girls.

programme.title: Fame (2009)
programme.desc: An inspiring story of a group of dancers, singers, musicians and actors at the NYC School of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Fed up with patriarch Mr. John Henry Brooks Jr.'s tyrannical rule, Mrs. Brooks and the kids are fighting back!

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: College Football featuring Duquesne at New Haven. From Ralph F. DellaCamera Stadium in West Haven, CT.
